method: Real wall time and requestAnimationFrame. QA-only god mode; Eminonu deadline extended in memory only. Keyboard movement and UI upgrades. Full-frame = successive rAF timestamps (includes pacing, not verified GPU presentation); JS callback CPU duration also recorded. Fixed-size histograms. Game rAF briefly stopped across forced GC and retained heap read; checkpointPauseMs recorded. Next 3 frame samples excluded and counted. No accelerated clock.
